summary: Title: Live updates: Bitcoin price slips toward $63,000 after CPI, AI stocks surge on Q2 beats URL Source: https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/08/12/live-updates-bitcoin-at-usd63-600-as-japan-s-metaplanet-moves-3-881-btc-between-wallets Published Time: 2026-08-12T07:04:53.726Z Markdown Content: coverage ended Aug 12, 2026, 9:38 PM ## Live updates: AI stocks surge on Q2 beats, bitcoin falls below $64,000 as inflation hits estimates Blockchain data shows the Japanese treasury firm moved the bitcoin between wallets it controls, not to an exchange, so the transfer isn't a sale despite its $1.4 billion paper loss. ![Image 1: Bitcoin (BTC) price on Wednesday Aug. 12 (CoinDesk)](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F0e89c972170359616d653de89e6701bec587d964-2028x1104.png%3Fauto%3Dformat&w=1920&q=75) Bitcoin (BTC) price on Wednesday Aug. 12 (CoinDesk) ![Image 2: Krisztian Sandor](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2Febf64cd21ae336f9f8dfbbfc5448be8092a8dd7f-2570x2570.png%3Fw%3D64%26h%3D64%26fit%3Dcrop%26crop%3Dfocalpoint%26auto%3Dformat&w=96&q=75) ## BitGo posts Q2 loss, CFO prepares to step down BitGo (BTGO) [swung to a loss](https://investors.bitgo.com/news/news-details/2026/BitGo-Announces-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx) in the second quarter even as revenue and institutional client activity grew, while the crypto custodian announced that chief financial officer Ed Reginelli will leave his role during the coming quarter.
